comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a terminal; record completes a wire splice with a twist-on connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate deflects one wire and probes beneath a locking tab; record evens two wire tips and repeatedly regrasps and twists a connector until snug.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires the selected terminal out without wire, crimp, or housing damage; record requires both wires captured, copper covered, connector snug, and hands released.
comparison.reason: Although both manipulate wires, twist-on capture and recessed-tab depinning test different mechanics.
